part.text:
Fixed in `src/expire.c:843`: the no-touch exemption now checks the command actually being executed (`server.executing_client`) rather than the script caller's command, so `TOUCH` inside scripts updates the key's access time even when the client has `CLIENT NO-TOUCH` enabled.

Validated:
- `unit/introspection-2` — all tests pass, including the new no-touch script case.
- `unit/scripting` — passes.
- The two broader-run failures (`unit/expire` TTL timing and `unit/introspection` loading timing) were unrelated flaky timing assertions; the TTL test passed when rerun alone.
